integrity: Proof uses exact trigonometric conditioning, a convergent arcsine power series, and an independently replayable standard-library verifier. Monte Carlo is corroborative only.
limitations: Normalized equiaffine arclength sampling only; this is not the Euclidean arclength case and no complete triangle-shape distribution is claimed. Related circle-enclosure dilogarithm law is already known; no external priority or independent proof audit has been completed.
title: Dilogarithmic acute-triangle law for equiaffine-uniform ellipses
